_comment: Study-3 human-evaluation stimuli: 6 personas x 3 policies = 18 sequences. Personas come from data/rq3_personas.json (designed by experiments/rq3/design_personas.py); the OCEAN values are copied inline so this file reproduces the stimulus set on its own. Per-persona seeds keep the three policies matched within a persona while stopping the personality-agnostic control from emitting one identical trail six times. n_cycles and selection_temperature must match the values the personas were selected under, or the measured separation no longer applies. Run: python -m experiments.rq3.gen_sequences --config configs/rq3_study.json --preview
_temperature_note: selection_temperature is per policy, matched on post-temperature output entropy (~0.56 nats over six locations) rather than set to one shared value. A shared value is not neutral: the controller applies it to whatever distribution a policy emits, and the scorer's is far flatter (top-1 location 0.27-0.35) than the hard-label-trained nonlinear model's (0.43-0.97). At a shared 0.1 the scorer sharpens into character while the nonlinear model locks onto one option for all ten cycles — which measures distribution sharpness, not what the model learned. The agnostic control takes the nonlinear model's temperature, not its own entropy match: it is that model with personality zeroed, so any second difference between them would confound the floor.
